pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate common ACP transport, AgentHost bridge, Claude/Codex/Goose adapters
- route first-class AI Studio agent Ask and Build plus normal Managed Local sessions through ACP
- preserve AgentHost-selected project-root/read-only and isolated-workspace/run-bound MCP authority
- add benchmark schema v4 Raw Model, Agent Harness, and Coding Agent runtime identities without reinterpreting schema v1-v3 evidence
- add campaign schema v3 frozen runtime identity and keep agent-inclusive evidence out of model-only routing/catalog recommendations
- keep ACP-unobservable model-turn/token telemetry explicitly unavailable

## Integration

Explicit ACP benchmark execution wiring, Cargo.lock generation, final Windows Validation, and any required final visual checks remain.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required; final integrated-head validation remains authoritative.
